scraperConfig.analyzerNotes: Oracle HCM Cloud Candidate Experience (Fusion Recruiting) site for ELCA. This is a JS-rendered Knockout/React SPA, so requires_js=true. Job cards are li[data-qa="searchResultItem"] (one talent-community CTA tile li[data-qa="searchResultTalentCommunityItem"] is excluded by the data-qa value). Detail URL is the href on a.job-list-item__link (e.g. .../job/2809/?...). Title is in span.job-tile__title. The external job ID is exposed as the id attribute on the inner search-result-item-header element (e.g. id="2809"), which matches the /job/{id}/ path segment. Location and posting date appear as labeled rows; selectors target the value next to the matching label. Note: some cards render location as plain text directly inside li.job-list-item__job-info-item (e.g. "Locations, Pully, Geneva") rather than the labeled .job-list-item__job-info-value structure, so the location selector may miss those — a fallback on the first .job-list-item__job-info-item text may be needed. Pagination: the visible page shows all 16 results at once with no Next/Load-more button in the markup; Oracle CX normally loads ~25 per request and uses a load-more button, but none is present here, so pagination_type=none. Company is not shown per-card (only as a facet/Organizations filter), so null. The keyword/location filters are passed via URL query params but these are search filters, not pagination, so url_param is not used.
